gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ this metro line run this late.
gaps.explanation: Rarely at the front: does + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: ___ I richer, I would travel the world.
gaps.explanation: Were I richer = If I were richer — formal inversion.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ the report mention the missing funds.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere does the report mention… — present simple inversion.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ the chances of success be improved by patience.
gaps.explanation: Little will the chances be improved… — inversion with future.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ we realise what he had done.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later did we realise' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last guest had left ___ she sit down.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … had left did she sit down' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the bridge unsafe, but it was also far too narrow.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the bridge unsafe' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: ___ it not been for the lifeguard, the boy would have drowned.
gaps.explanation: 'Had it not been for …' = 'If it had not been for …'.
